caseName: National City Bank of Cleveland v. Euclid-Doan Co.
caseNameFull: National City Bank of Cleveland, Trustee v. Euclid-Doan Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Clan Crawford and Frank Harrison for petitioner. Messrs. James A. Butler and Morris Berick for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
